name: Witch Doctor: percentage cost/effectiveness passives work natively (#979, #2877, #1290)
contract: Wizened 705903/705904 ("Increases your maximum mana by $s1% and reduces the mana cost of spells and abilities by $s2%"): effect0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_ENERGY_PERCENT (132) EffectBasePoints 4/9 (5%/10%), handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModIncreaseEnergyPercent (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4693) via Unit::ApplyStatPctModifier on UNIT_MOD_POWER_START+POWER_MANA; effect1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_POWER_COST_SCHOOL_PCT (72) MiscValue 127 (all schools) EffectBasePoints -4/-7 (-3%/-6%), handled by AuraEffect::HandleModPowerCostPCT (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5254) via UNIT_FIELD_POWER_COST_MULTIPLIER, consumed multiplicatively in SpellInfo::CalculateManaCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3093-3100: powerCost = int32(powerCost * (1.0f + powerCostMultiplier))) regardless of the caster's spell family. Stranglethorn Style 705877/705878 ("Increases your critical strike chance by $s1% and reduces threat generated by your Voodoo spells by $s2%" / rank2: "Increases Nature Damage dealt by $s1% and healing done by $s2%"): rank1 effect0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290) MiscValue 0, EffectBasePoints 3 (4%), handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4892), which ignores misc value/class mask and raises Player::UpdateAllSpellCritChances globally (documented gap in .agents/docs/systems/ascension-spell-parity.md:360, harmless here since the tooltip itself is unscoped); rank1 effect1 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108) op SPELLMOD_THREAT (2, SpellDefines.h:78) EffectSpellClassMask [.,.,.,28,33850384,2097152,.,.,.] EffectBasePoints -21 (-20%), generic Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219-10328); this classmask matches real Witch Doctor (SpellFamilyName 19) offensive spells, confirmed directly against Bad Juju 802087's own SpellFamilyFlags [0,1024,2] (1024 & 33850384 = 1024 != 0, 2 & 2097152 = 2 != 0). Rank2 swaps to effect0 aura 79 MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE MiscValue 8 (Nature) EffectBasePoints 3 (4%) and effect1 aura 136 MOD_HEALING_DONE_PERCENT MiscValue 127 (all schools) EffectBasePoints 5 (6%) -- a real clause swap between ranks, not a partial rank. Potent Mixes 503748/504888 ("Increases your healing done by $s1% and reduces the threat generated by your spells by $s2%"): effect0 aura 136 MiscValue 127 EffectBasePoints 3/7 (4%/8%); effect1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_THREAT (103) EffectBasePoints -16/-31 (flat -15/-30, not a percent -- the DBC record itself does not encode a true percent-threat aura; SPELL_AURA_MOD_THREAT is the percent one and is not what this spell uses), handled by AuraEffect::HandleAuraModTotalThreat (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:3671) -> ThreatManager::UpdateMyTempModifiers (ThreatManager.cpp:798-816), a generic flat additive threat offset already wired into live threat math. The harness metric catalog (apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md) has no threat/aggro metric, so both threat clauses are proven only by aura_amount/spell_modifier presence with the exact shipped signed amount, not by a measured combat threat delta -- recorded per the investigation's proof-limitation note, not a gap in this scenario. None of these 15 spell ids appear under src/server/coa/ or modules/mod-ascension/ and none of the rank pairs are registered in `spell_ranks` (SpellMgr::LoadSpellRanks, SpellMgr.cpp:1310), so each rank is learned and unlearned explicitly rather than relying on automatic supersession.
